waived.msg: a shader uses "common" as a name (line 7: #include <common>): GLSL ES reserves it, so a strict GPU rejects the whole shader and the picture stays empty
waived.fix: rename it (flat, smooth, centroid, sample, patch, input, output, filter and the rest are GLSL ES reserved words)
waived.reason: '#include <common>' is a three.js preprocessor include that three.js replaces with source before the shader reaches the GPU; 'common' never appears as a GLSL identifier. The hero also keeps its still drawing unless every shader program reports runnable (TimberFrame3D.tsx).
